rule.question: does the select leg's money sit on names bought at the last decision or on names the book already held
rule.attribution: pp_i = w_i * (r_i - r_bench), summed over bars and annualised; sum over equity names == the select leg, sum over the rest == the rotate leg
rule.fresh: a name in the new book that was not in the book at the previous decision
rule.primary_test: within-period label permutation of which held names were new, counts held fixed, statistic = mean pp per fresh name minus mean pp per incumbent name
secondary: book-vs-index 60-bar correlation at the decision (median split)
2x2 of those two with a label-shuffle best-cell null
rule.frozen: criteria written before the run; --check re-derives them off the period table on disk

beta.read: 指数自己的涨跌贡献 0.47pp，占全书 9.78pp/年 的 4.8%——剩下的都不是 beta。相关系数回答的是另一个问题：指数下跌时这本书会不会跟着跌（相关 0.43，R² 0.18）。（这里的年化是 bar 算术均值的年化，指数几何年化约 0.1%，两个口径不要混读。）

fresh_perm.statistic: mean pp per fresh name - per incumbent name
fresh_perm.null: which of a period's held names were new, counts held fixed

turn_split.null: period pp shuffled across periods, split sizes held fixed

corr_split.null: period pp shuffled across periods, split sizes held fixed

era.note: one cell passing the null is a lead; an edge that changes sign between eras is a period pileup

sentence: 新名字与老名字单车贡献分不开：新 +0.029pp vs 留 +0.009pp，差 +0.020pp，同周期打乱「哪几只是新的」2000 次里 81% 能造出一样大的差——这本书的钱既不是换名字买来的，也不是坐着拿来的。
